title: payment-api error-rate SLO burn
description: Customers report card payments failing or stuck in pending. payment-api shows elevated latency and intermittent 5xx responses.
root_cause_detail: External dependency acquirer-gateway degraded and responded slowly; payment-api calls exceeded the 5000ms client timeout. The degradation was intermittent (flapping).
expected_symptoms: payment-api downstream_latency_ms rises from ~164ms to ~5.1s (client timeout 5000ms)
timeout and retry logs on calls from payment-api to acquirer-gateway
payment-api p95 latency rises to ~5.2s, error rate up to ~3.3%
payment-api CPU and memory stay near baseline
resolution: Failed over to the secondary acquirer-gateway region and tuned the payment-api timeout and retry budget.
